_comment: One knowledge base data source per Confluence space and per group of Jira projects (a Jira source is a custom data source that the app's monitor fills with the issues, their comments and their attachments): a user's grants are a list of these, and every search is filtered to them. A knowledge base holds at most 5 data sources (a fixed quota), so each source names its knowledge base; the app searches every poc3-kb* knowledge base the user has a grant in. A Confluence source with "text": true gets a second data source, <name>-text, that the monitor fills with the text of the attachments the knowledge base's parser reads badly (pptx, docx, doc, pdf, scans, pictures); the app shows the two as one source. A $NAME value is read from infra/local.env. SharePoint folders are no longer a source here (removed 2026-11-14); a "sharepoint" list of { name: "sp-...", kb, title, folders } still works.
